_readme: The one model price table of Observer: the Python SDK (pricing.py) and the backend (app/cost.py, which ships a copy checked equal by backend/tests/test_cost.py) both read it. Prices per 1M tokens, USD, standard paid API, no batch or cache discounts. Every price names its source and the day it was checked. A model that is not here has no price (not the same as free). `changes` lists later prices by start date. `unpriced` names models known to have no published price, with the reason.
